title: Adopt Dioxus native portal after web target support
description:
## Problem
`primitives/src/portal.rs` stores an `Element` and later renders it beneath `PortalOut`. Dioxus mounts portaled component scopes under outlet rather than source tree. Arbitrary source-tree contexts are unavailable in dialogs and overlays unless each required context is explicitly re-provided.

## Current state
Dioxus PR #5554 introduces native `Portal`: physical renderer placement changes without changing component ownership, context, or event propagation. Its core implementation addresses this scope-loss mechanism.

#5554 is 0.8 alpha work. It does not provide dioxus-web support required here: register browser overlay DOM root as `RenderTargetId`, route mutations through multi-target web writer, and route browser events to correct target. Therefore dioxus-components cannot yet replace workaround. Continue explicit context bridging where portaled content requires it.

## Solution
When compatible Dioxus release has native browser portal targets, replace `PortalIn`/`PortalOut` workaround with native `Portal`, use application-owned browser overlay target, and remove context bridges required solely by old portal scope boundary.
acceptance_criteria:
- Compatible Dioxus native Portal supports browser-owned overlay DOM target.
- Dialog content reads arbitrary source-tree Dioxus contexts without manual re-provisioning.
- Portaled Dialog DOM mounts outside application root.
- Targeted browser regression test proves DOM placement and context availability.
- Legacy primitives PortalIn/PortalOut and context-only bridges are removed.
